DZr-jfgSlzE.creator: anjalipandey_yoga
DZr-jfgSlzE.text: While growing up, I never really understood why some people cared so much about little things. The details, the rituals, the things they return to day after day. I always thought, why does it matter so much? And then over the years, as yoga became a bigger part of my life, I started realizing something. The things we return to every day matter. Not because they are necessary, but because they make us feel something. The practice, the breath, those rituals, all these little things, reminds us of who we are. The longer I've practiced, the more I've come to appreciate all these small things. It was always about how it made them feel. Grounded, present, and so much connected to themselves.
